peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 36.2% above its local comparables; 84 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (22.7): 1.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 58 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 37.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $3,255,000 ($2,459 psf, 1,313–1,334 sq ft; 6 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,805 psf (range $1,527–2,050); 36.2% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $866,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Lorong Chuan MRT about 140 m, Serangoon MRT about 1,040 m; closer than 443 of 462 similar developments (the same as 4). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 4 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest ST. Gabriel's Primary School about 380 m; more than 409 of 462 similar developments (the same as 53). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 1 supermarket within 1 km (nearest about 960 m), more than 18 of 462 similar developments (the same as 37); nearest hawker centre Serangoon Garden Market about 1,240 m; nearest park Kallang Linear Park about 750 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming: Tavistock MRT (Cross Island Line) about 1,800 m, under construction; LTA target 2030. Straight-line distance to the planned station site; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 3 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Chuan Park, 115 new sales, about 340 m; Jansen House, 10 new sales, about 1,760 m; The Orie, 25 new sales, about 2,000 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 97 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 150 new sales and 539 resales (689 purchases); new sales were 21.8% of these purchases. Subsales (26) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: One Chuan Grove (government land sale site, awarded, about 1,060 homes), about 320 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 539 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 126 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 539 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 603 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−10.6%). Planning-area private resales −15.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
